title: Compare two individually authorized completed Search Job run summaries in memory
goal: After a completed first-party owner-authorized Search Job, let the analyst pin bounded provenance metadata for an in-memory reference, run a distinct authorized search for the same Case/session, and compare counts, Query versions and UTC scopes without persisting a Trace, bearer, source name or event reference.
invariants: Both compared runs must originate from the existing completed first-party owner-authorized Search Job; the second run never borrows the first run's source authority.
Store only bounded numeric aggregates and safe Job metadata in ephemeral JS memory; no raw result refs, source names, bearer, event payload, audit body or new fetch.
Missing metadata is explicitly unavailable; never claim causal change, actor, historical integrity, Shared Trace or accepted canonical CAP-INV-008.
OPEN-015 and OPEN-013 remain unresolved. Browser placement remains a synthetic lab boundary.
security_properties: The comparison baseline is destroyed on token/Case/Timeline context change or any denied/invalid Search Job.
A second Job can only compare against the same Case and owner-scope revision and must have different RunID.
No additional source requests, credential retention or browser persistent storage; no partial comparison after failure.

migration.rationale: Ephemeral browser-only provenance projection, no new database or audit event.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional ephemeral baseline button and diff panel; retain CAP-INV-008A single-run provenance unchanged.
verification: Existing source-authorized Event Search and CAP-INV-007 result workspace tests continue unchanged.

inputs: Already owner-authorized completed Event Search Job from the transient CAP-INV-008A first-party browser.
Operator explicitly pins safe bounded run metadata and executes a second owner-authorized completed job in the same Case and bearer scope.
Canonical CAP-INV-008 Class-0 run comparison semantics and canonical Shared Search Job type.
outputs: A deterministic two-run transient difference of counts, Query version and UTC scope, never a persisted Trace.
Browser tests showing two real completed authorized Job responses and cleanup on bearer/Case/denied second Job.
Traceable exact SHA GitHub CI status and independent material L2 handoff.
acceptance_tests: Two successively completed owner-authorized Search Jobs produce an in-memory summary difference of result counts, source/error/audit counts and Query/UTC metadata.
Missing source or failure metadata produces unavailable rather than zero; never retain raw labels/ref IDs in comparison.
Rotating bearer/Case or rejecting malformed/foreign second Job clears prior baseline and publishes no partial comparison.
Run exact HEAD runtime and security CI without waiving mandatory coverage.

performance_budget.rationale: O(1) bounded provenance metadata and count comparison; no new remote query beyond an operator-requested Search Job.
metrics: O(1) comparison; at most two records in ephemeral provenance state.
No extra source dereference or HTTP endpoint.

definition_of_ready: Engineering source CAP-INV-008A is IMPLEMENTED on frozen parent SHA but not VERIFIED; this bounded extension is only a development candidate, never a release-ready unit until the parent 90% security gate passes.
Class-0 Compare runs is explicitly canonical, uses pre-existing Job and temporary browser state only, and does not require OPEN-015 storage.
Expected production change is limited to the existing one Search Job UI context and 2 executable files.
definition_of_done: Real browser behavior test two different completed authorized runs in same scope, missing metadata and no secret/ref disclosure.
Bearer/Case changes and malformed second Job discard comparison; no additional network/source requests.
Exact HEAD Linux Go+Node/macOS/Windows and mandatory unchanged 90% engineering security gate reported, independent L2 review when published.
